desc.en: A metal cog that has rusted due to being left alone for a long time. It can be used, but it would probably be best to just replace it.
desc.ja: 長い間、放置されたためにさびついてしまった金属の歯車。かろうじて使うことはできるが、素直に取り替えたほうがいい

desc.en: Effect: There is a 15％ chance not to consume use count of the item during battle, but it will consume MP instead.
desc.ja: 効果：戦闘中、１５％の確率で使用回数が減らなくなるが、ＭＰを少し消費する
